pr_body:
Add hotkey to "cinema" mod as in osu!stable.

Closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/9221.
pr_comments: This has been attempted once before in #9224, and as far as I can see, [this implementation suffers from the exact same bug that prevented that one from being merged](https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/9224#issuecomment-640112999).
I'm not even sure we want this. Cinema is such a rare use case that I feel it probably doesn't need its own dedicated (hidden) hotkey..

issue_context.title: Cinema mod shortcut not implemented
issue_context.body: **Describe the feature:** Shortcut is <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Enter</kbd>. Right now it just enables autoplay (because of <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Enter</kbd>) in song select.
comments: Closing for now as it seems that the shortcut is not used a lot as commented in the linked PRs. May come back as a global hotkey (https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/6092#issuecomment-531557940).

review_comments: this text should depend on the hotkey pressed, not be an either/or catch-all

I don't agree with this being handled locally as done here. The higher-level logic of mod selection/deselection should be deselecting one when the other is selected, via `IncompatibleMods` or similar. (see #7155) Otherwise we're going to end up with local fixes every time an issue like this arises.

That was also another problem the previous attempt at this had.
